title: Cobblemon Field Guide
description: Adds an in-game guidebook that can lookup all kinds of information about a Cobblemon Pokemon: Drops, Spawns, Evolutions, Moves, and more!
body:
![Field Guide Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21f95182a016b8c20cced36bebd21ae443b9af9a_0.webp)


Introducing Cobblemon Field Guide.

Quickly look up the in-game information on any Pokemon in your modpack.  

Works as a client-only mod, BUT - some guide information is NOT available to the client.  As such, you will need to install it on the server to get information like Spawns (only available on the server).

Gain the ability to lookup the information on any Pokemon, even if it's a fakemon, or modified for your specific modpack.

Includes the ability to lookup:

Drops
Spawns
Evolutions
Moves
Breeding Information
Abilities

Press F10 in-game (configurable hoteky) and type the name of the Pokemon you want to lookup.  You do not need to own the Pokemon - making this the ideal tool to lookup the spawn conditions of a rare pokemon you have not caught yet.



You are allowed to add this to your modpack if desired.
